# Boho By The Beach

> A boutique beach resort in Morjim, North Goa, offering garden view and pool view accommodations just minutes from the famous Olive Ridley turtle nesting beach.

Boho By The Beach is a pet-friendly boutique resort located in Morjim, North Goa, positioned a 2-minute walk from Morjim Beach. The resort caters to families, couples, and groups seeking affordable yet serene beachside accommodation with easy access to North Goa's beaches including Ashwem, Mandrem, and Vagator.
